result:
Done. Only two files needed changing — nothing else in the repo hardcoded the path.

**`products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx`** (the source of truth): the route key and the `decisionPlayground` URL builder both changed from `/ml-inference/decisions` to `/ml-inference/playground`.

**`frontend/src/products.tsx`**: the generated mirror of every manifest — same two lines, in `productRoutes` and `productUrls`.

I hand-edited the generated file rather than running `frontend/build-products.mjs`, since `node_modules` isn't installed here and you asked me not to install. The edit matches what the generator would emit: it collects routes and urls in manifest-file order without sorting keys (`build-products.mjs:60-100`), so renaming a key in place doesn't move it, and the change is a pure string substitution at the same two positions.

Nothing else pointed at the old address. Every other consumer already went through `urls.decisionPlayground()`:

- `products/ml_inference/frontend/DecisionPlayground.stories.tsx:55` (`pageUrl`)
- the scene lazy-import map in `frontend/src/productScenes.tsx:134`, keyed on the scene name, not the path

The manifest declares no `treeItemsProducts`, so there's no nav/menu entry carrying the URL, and `frontend/src/products.json` (the Python-facing extract) only includes tree items, so it's unaffected. A repo-wide grep for `ml-inference/decisions` now returns nothing. The `ml-inference-decisions` feature flag key (`frontend/src/lib/constants.tsx:412`, `products/ml_inference/backend/logic/decisions.py:33`) is unrelated to the URL and I left it alone.

No test change. The scene, its logic, and the API are untouched, and the route map is generated from the manifest, so a test asserting `urls.decisionPlayground() === '/ml-inference/playground'` would only restate the generated artifact rather than catch a regression. No existing test referenced the old path.

Two things worth flagging:

- **Old links will 404.** You said "instead of", so I did a straight replacement and did not add a redirect. The manifest supports a `redirects` map (AI observability uses it to forward the retired `/llm-analytics/playground` and `/llm-observability/playground`), so if you want bookmarks to keep working, say so and I'll add `'/ml-inference/decisions'` there.
- The working tree also contains unrelated in-progress edits under `products/slack_app/` (untagged follow-up mode defaults). Those aren't mine and I left them untouched — worth separating before you commit.
